kill_criteria: Fragmentation not shown to be a material, causal driver of delivery delay across >=2 regions and >=2 workload types; or as-benefit-attribution-factor cannot be empirically estimated above the assumed 25% base case; or adoption falls below 70% in any participating region with no credible remediation; or a costed incremental-toolchain comparison shows equivalent benefit at materially lower cost
next_decision: SCALE the platform investment if the evidence gate is met; HOLD or STOP and return to incremental toolchain improvements if not
